entities.summary: Daniel Andrew Williamson, better known as LTJ Bukem, is a British jungle musician, producer and DJ. He and his record label Good Looking are most associated with the jazzy, atmospheric side of Jungle music. LTJ Bukem was a composers & musicians from London (b. 1967, London). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
